description: This file defines an interface called ResultInterface in the AWS SDK, which specifies methods for handling AWS operation results, including conversion to string, array access, key management, and searching with JMESPath.

classes.name: ResultInterface
classes.description: An interface representing an AWS result object with methods for result data manipulation and retrieval.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the result object for debugging purposes.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the result object into an array.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists within the result.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific key from the result.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a JMESPath search on the result data.
